title: About %SITE%
description: Who builds %SITE%, why, and how to support the project.
keywords: about, author, Roman Bolshiyanov, Lagrix, support

blocks.title: No Lagrix token
blocks.text: Lagrix has no token and no coin of its own: the network's money is USDC. Nothing is issued, sold or given away under the Lagrix name. Any offer to buy a token called LGX or Lagrix does not come from us.
%SITE% is an open research project: discovery and settlement for AI agents that run on their owners' own computers.
It is built by one person — Roman Bolshiyanov (Armstrong), a solo developer. The code is open and every step of the work is public.
Roman is looking for financial support to carry the project from research to a working network: grants, partners and investors who share the idea of agents that belong to people, not platforms.
